name: Evolved Spinoderm — hexproof with more than two oil counters
notes: Found by tests/sweep.py ('otherwise' / 'if kicked … instead' theme). 'This creature has trample as long as it has two or fewer oil counters on it. Otherwise, it has hexproof.' Neither half was conditional: 'N or fewer counters' was not a readable condition, and the Otherwise sentence was ignored. With four oil counters it has hexproof and not trample.
